findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "rayana_ai_start_checkout" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rayana_ai_portfolio, rayana_ai_start_checkout · Private data: rayana_ai_plans, rayana_ai_start_checkout · Public sink: rayana_ai_ticker, rayana_ai_analyst_brief, rayana_ai_portfolios.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rayana_ai_portfolio, rayana_ai_start_checkout · Private data: rayana_ai_plans, rayana_ai_start_checkout · Public sink: rayana_ai_ticker, rayana_ai_analyst_brief, rayana_ai_portfolios

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
